front.title: A Registry of Announced, Filed and Deployed Satellite Constellations

abstract.t:
Aggregate figures for the number of satellites planned for low Earth orbit are widely quoted and rarely traceable. They mix quantities that are not comparable: satellites already in orbit, satellites a national regulator has authorised, satellites applied for and not yet granted, and satellites that exist only in an announcement. For a single system these can differ by orders of magnitude. Which one a headline figure refers to decides whether it describes infrastructure or intent.
This document describes a community-maintained registry that keeps the four apart and requires every number in it to carry a citation and an evidence grade. It sets out the data model, the taxonomy of regulatory commitment, the rules that separate primary regulatory sources from secondary reporting, and the criteria for inclusion.
